title: Target Tor coordinates localize on explicit algebraic ideal-wedge images
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], $n\in\mathbf N$, $B=i_*\mathcal O_Z$, and $Q=i^*H^{-n}(B[0]\otimes^{\mathbf L}B[0])$ for the fixed derived tensor [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure, def-pc-module-pullback]. For each affine $U$, put $A_U=\Gamma(Y,U)$, $I_U=i.\ker.\operatorname{ideal}(U)$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], $O_U=i^{-1}U$, and let $F_U,\gamma_U$ and $w_U(b)$ be the affine functor, explicit section map and conormal ideal wedge of [new-t2-self-tor-affine-section]. Write $c_U:\bigwedge^n_{A_U/I_U}(I_U/I_U^2)\to\operatorname{Tor}^{A_U}_n(A_U/I_U,A_U/I_U)$ for [new-r4-self-tor-conormal-comparison]. There is a shared family $t_U:F_U(\operatorname{Tor}^{A_U}_n(A_U/I_U,A_U/I_U))|_{O_U}\simeq Q|_{O_U}$. For affine $V\subset U$ with $V=D(f)$ for $f\in A_U$ and $b:\operatorname{Fin}(n)\to\Gamma(U,i.\ker)$, the component of $t_U$ over $O_V$, applied to the restriction of $\gamma_U(c_U(w_U(b)))$, equals the top component of $t_V$ applied to $\gamma_V(c_V(w_V(b|_V)))$. No exterior sheaf source coordinate or wedge of conormal unit sections appears here.

proof.text: Sheafify the augmented projective quotient resolution on each affine U. The bounded-above flat resolution computes the fixed derived tensor by K-flat augmentation comparison. The quotient ideal annihilates its homology, giving the displayed target coordinate after tensor pullback. Choose these target coordinates for all U.

For b defined on U, lift the Koszul augmentation to that quotient resolution. Its quotient-tensored top wedge is a cycle and selfTorConormalComparison_spec identifies its image with c_U(w_U(b)). Localize at f and compare the localized resolution with the chosen resolution on V over their augmentations. Homotopic Koszul lifts have equal homology classes; normalization on V identifies that class with c_V(w_V(b restricted)). The K-flat augmented comparison commutes with restriction, and the explicit affine section construction represents those same classes in Q. This proves only the algebraic-image equality; no source-coordinate assertion, denominator clearing or sheaf descent occurs. Degree zero is the quotient unit; empty charts and zero quotients have unique sections.

theorem exists_selfTor_target_basic_localization
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (n : ℕ) :
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let Q := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (-(n : ℤ))).obj
          (S.obj B ⊗ S.obj B))
    let T := fun U : Y.affineOpens ↦
      tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.1.ι ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i
    let c := fun U : Y.affineOpens ↦
      selfTorConormalComparison (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) (i.ker.ideal U) n
    ∃ t : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens,
        ((T U).obj _).over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ≅ Q.over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1),
      ∀ (V U : Y.affineOpens) (h : V.1 ≤ U.1)
        (_hbasic : ∃ f : Γ(Y, U.1), Y.basicOpen f = V.1)
        (b : Fin n → i.ker.toModules.val.obj (op U.1)),
        (t U).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (i.preimage_mono h))))
            (((T U).obj _).val.map (homOfLE (i.preimage_mono h)).op
              (selfTorAffineSection i U _ ((c U) (selfTorIdealWedge i U n b)))) =
          (t V).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (i ⁻¹ᵁ V.1))))
            (selfTorAffineSection i V _ ((c V) (selfTorIdealWedge i V n
              (fun j ↦ i.ker.toModules.val.map (homOfLE h).op (b j)))))
